<h2>Three themes and a vision</h2>
<p>The Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> has been built around 3 connected themes that form the structure of the Strategy:&nbsp;<span lang="mi">Mahi Tika</span>&nbsp;— Trust,&nbsp;<span lang="mi">Mahi Tahi</span>&nbsp;— Inclusion, and&nbsp;<span lang="mi">Mahi Ake</span>&nbsp;— Growth. These themes are supported by goals and measures.</p>
<p>Measuring progress against Trust, Inclusion and Growth will help us to realise our vision for a digital <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> New Zealand:</p>
<blockquote>
<p lang="mi">Te whakaāhei i te puāwaitanga me te taurikura o te katoa o Aotearoa i roto i te ao matihiko.</p>
<p>Enabling all of <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> New Zealand to flourish and prosper in a digital world.</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<h2>Read the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> in English and <span lang="mi">te reo Māori</span></h2>
<ul>
<li><a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/237~the-digital-strategy-for-aotearoa/html">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span></a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-English-PDF.pdf"><span lang="mi">Digital Strategy for Aotearoa</span> (PDF 3.8MB)</a></li>
<li><a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/236~te-rautaki-matihiko-mo-aotearoa/html"><span lang="mi">Te Rautaki Matihiko mō Aotearoa</span></a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-Te-Reo-Maori-PDF.pdf"><span lang="mi">Te Rautaki Matihiko mō Aotearoa</span> (PDF 1.2MB)</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
<h2>Alternate formats</h2>
<p>A summary of the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> is available in the following formats.</p>
<h3>Audio</h3>
<p><a href="https://youtu.be/COyLj5HbpmA?si=Z7m46iQv27Bj38ku">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Youtube</a></p>
<h3>Braille</h3>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-Executive-Summary-Braille.brf">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span>— Executive summary (BRF 9KB)</a></p>
<h3>Easy Read</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/DSA-Executive-Summary-Easy-Read-Word.docx">Digital Strategy for Aotearoa — Executive summary (Word 9.9MB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/DSA-Executive-Summary-Easy-Read-PDF.pdf">Digital Strategy for Aotearoa — Executive summary (PDF 3.2MB)</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Large print</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-Executive-Summary-Large-Print.docx">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span>&nbsp;— Executive summary (Word 62KB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-Executive-Summary-Large-Print.pdf">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span>&nbsp;— Executive summary (PDF 164KB)</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>New Zealand Sign Language (NZSL)</h3>
<p><a href="https://youtu.be/N9hMoJT2Qbk?si=U7vvXVvwWrNXPrVj">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Youtube</a></p>
<h2>Digital Executive Board</h2>
<p>The Digital Executive Board was established under the <a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.legislation.govt.nz/act/public/2020/40/en/latest/#LMS106159">Public Service Act 2020</a> to lead and drive the implementation of the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> and its associated Action Plan.</p>
<h2>Background to the Digital Strategy</h2>
<p>A cross-agency team worked together on developing this Strategy. The team was made up of representatives from:</p>
<ul>
<li><span lang="mi">Hīkina Whakatutuki</span> the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment</li>
<li><span lang="mi">Te Tari Taiwhenua</span> Department of Internal Affairs</li>
<li><span lang="mi">Te Tari o Te Pirimia me Te Komiti Matua</span> Department of Prime Minister and Cabinet</li>
<li><span lang="mi">Tatauranga Aotearoa</span> Stats NZ.</li>
</ul>
<p>The discussion document Towards a Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span>&nbsp;was released for public submissions in late 2021. Through an engagement process, held from October to December 2021, the team drew on the knowledge and ideas of hundreds of New Zealanders and organisations to develop the final Strategy.</p>
<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<h3>Read the discussion document and Summary of Public Engagement</h3>
<ul>
<li><a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/193~towards-a-digital-strategy-for-aotearoa/html">Towards a Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa<span></span></span></a></li>
<li><a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy/Towards-a-Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-discussion-document.pdf">Towards a Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> (PDF 3.6MB)</a></li>
<li><a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/229~towards-a-digital-strategy-for-aotearoa-summary-of-public-engagement/html">What we heard&nbsp;— Summary of Public Engagement</a></li>
<li><a class="ss-broken" href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy/Digital-Strategy-Public-Engagement-summary.pdf">What we heard&nbsp;— Summary of Public Engagement (PDF 1.7MB)</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
